title: Are you using the wrong combination for your strategy?
subtitle: Forex, indices, cryptocurrencies, equities, commodities. TradeScope cross-matches asset, strategy, horizon, capital, and leverage with a real cost database to identify the most efficient instrument and broker.
cta_note: Asset, strategy, horizon. Then the ranking.
trust: The engine reads the operational combination and applies spread, funding, commissions, and instrument structure before comparing instruments and brokers.
trust_point_1: The combination is evaluated for consistency between asset, strategy, and horizon.
trust_point_2: Costs are read as execution friction and holding friction.
trust_point_3: The ranking changes when the context changes. There is no universally best instrument.
visual_note: The same underlying can have very different efficiencies depending on the instrument used.
monitor_row_1_note: The result depends almost entirely on spread and slippage.
monitor_row_2_note: Execution quality and overnight management directly impact the edge.
monitor_row_3_note: Funding and market structure influence results more than the setup.
